<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Decision logic is pure and clock-free in pij-core, next to IdleEdge: a per-PA PrimeActive tracker consumes one observation per round (worker idle-edge fired, PA idle, prime idle, prime working, any delivery to the prime since arming) and returns a verdict. It owns no I/O. The daemon's PaWatchdog::round is the only composition root: it reads the registry/roles, finds the prime (current designation, else the prime-role seat in scope), reads delivery receipts for the prime from the spine since the arming tick, consults the tracker, and sends through the existing delivery + audit_cold_wake path. Delivery is the brake input, read from the authority (spine), never inferred from the prime's state. |
| composition_root | crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs (PaWatchdog::round) |
| contracts | crates/core/src/watchdog.rs: PrimeActive tracker, observe(PrimeObservation) -&gt; PrimeVerdict {Wake, Braked, Capped, Waiting}; episode reset tied to IdleEdge's working-&gt;idle edge, pij_core reason constant PRIME_ACTIVE_REASON = "prime-active" beside IDLE_WAKE_REASON |

<a id="fan-out"></a>

## Fan out

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| decision | solo-pm |
| rationale | One tightly coupled change: the tracker's states and the round's wiring share one episode lifecycle with #52's IdleEdge, in two files plus tests. Splitting it would create a frozen interface for a single consumer. One coder implements, and a cross-model reviewer reviews the whole change. |
